name: v0.121.1
body:
### Bug Fixes

- extract the quality gate debug artifact outside the checkout [PR [#3875](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3875) @wagoodman]
- incorrect constraint for versionless purls in openvex [PR [#3874](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3874) @kzantow]
- report additional version-range records for a package [PR [#3782](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3782) @jspilman]
- report a package's vulnerability as added or removed only when its affected record set changes [PR [#3784](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3784) @jspilman]
- report the lowest overlapping AlmaLinux fix [PR [#3783](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3783) @jspilman]
- report fix date and kind changes under the package [PR [#3781](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3781) @jspilman]
- label db diff databases in the order they were provided [PR [#3816](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3816) @bot190]
- time out stalled db diff downloads [PR [#3858](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3858) @wagoodman]
- only remove db diff directories that grype created [PR [#3828](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3828) @wagoodman]
- make db diff --packages and --vulns include only what was requested [PR [#3815](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3815) @bot190]

### Performance

- index ignore rules by vulnerability ID [PR [#3817](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3817) @juanjsebgarcia]
- speed up db diff and reduce its memory and temp disk use [PR [#3813](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3813) @bot190]

### Additional Changes

- grype 0.119.0 allocates without bound on a CycloneDX machine-learning-model component with no purl and no CPE [Issue [#3767](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3767)]
- add a directory for grype-specific match labels [PR [#3849](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3849) @wagoodman]
- let go-make own the go version and move images to debian13 [PR [#3840](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3840) @wagoodman]
